messages:
mike: ran a bunch of perf passes overnight against mistral-14b with AWQ/INT8 profiles. saw a weird tail at higher microbatch sizes (>12) when kv cache is hot, latency jump ~2.1x
alyssa: can you share the kernel chooser output and batcher config?
mike: pasted logs, short snippet: ```kernel=matmul_fused_v3 selected for head_kv_dim=64; batcher=continuous_v2; kv_policy=prefix_cache; sequence=1024; batch=16; p50=42ms p95=310ms p99=540ms```
priya: that p99 looks like thrashing, maybe prefetch + stride issue when head_kv alignment != 64. what are the head/kv dims for this model?
mike: mistral-14b in our catalog: heads=64, head_kv=64, rope_scale=1.0 (no scaling). interestingly when we force kernel=matmul_simple the p99 drops to ~180ms but p50 rises a bit.
ben: so kernel_fused is faster for p50 but unstable for p99 at high batch. could be memory allocator / KV spill to host. did allocator show any evictions?
mike: yes during the p99 window there are repeated KV evict logs: `kv_cache_evicted=1, spill_to_host=yes, allocator_frag=0.31`
alyssa: might be related to our continuous batching heuristics: we pack until latency SLO, then flush; with long sequences the per-request KV working set grows. If the batcher defers flush to maximize GPU utilization you can step over memory cliffs.
priya: good call. can we try: 1) reduce max_microbatch to 12, 2) enable sticky-kv (keep KV pinned to GPU), 3) fall back to matmul_simple when spill occurs.
mike: ran a quick tweak: max_microbatch=12 + sticky-kv on, p99=195ms, p50=46ms, throughput down 8% but much less tail.
ben: for quantization note: AWQ seems to pick aggressive kernel that expects contiguous KV layout. GPTQ builds maintain slightly different strides. we should add a kernel compatibility matrix for AWQ vs GPTQ/FP8 to selector.
alyssa: add a small calibration test: prompt set of 50 samples (mix long/short) to measure accuracy delta vs int8 AWQ when we swap kernels. record token-level perplexity and answer fidelity.
infra-bot: perf-run 2496543210 completed: artifacts at s3://redwood-prod/perf/2496543210/ (profiles + kernel-chooser logs)
priya: i'll open an action item: add kernel-compat matrix + change default batcher policy for mistral-14b to max_microbatch=12 for AWQ. filing PR and adding perf numbers to the rollout notes. :memo:
mike: thanks — will attach pprof flame and allocator traces to the PR.
